Companion app for **Chusma New Gen**.

iOS only lets an installed app own a notification section, so a tweak on its own cannot post real system notifications. This app holds that permission, and Chusma publishes its alerts through it — landing on the lock screen and in Notification Center instead of drawing its own banner.

Open it once, grant notification access, then choose **Chusma App** as the Notification Sender in Settings › Chusma. You can leave it closed after that.

The same app is also offered as a `.tipa` for TrollStore. Pick one — installing both is a bundle ID conflict and TrollStore will refuse.

TrollStore registers the app through `installd`, which gives it a more complete install record. If notification permission won't stick after installing this package, uninstall it and use the `.tipa` instead.
